text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've sent Dana the list in our DM. Moss's notes contain two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

  #4419: from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support. The note has no date.

Moss has four other notes, and none of them has a Quarrendon ticket number. #4409, #4412 and FR-882 appear in the Central notes, but they belong to Central team accounts. Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a customer, so I left it out.

I also gave her two numbers that don't come from Moss: #4912 is in the Quarrendon account profile, and #8841 is in her own 9 Apr renewal debrief notes. The debrief also has pricing in it, but I only passed on the ticket number.
